name: Moore Neighbourhood Sampling
definition: A function to read all 27 voxels in a 3x3x3 Moore neighbourhood centered on a given voxel, returning their values and a bitmask of non-empty voxels.
summary: Moore Neighbourhood Sampling reads all 27 voxels in a 3x3x3 block and returns a bitmask of non-empty neighbors, distinguished by its fixed exhaustive scope rather than physics-based radius search.
